subject: Activity Log Handoff, Retention Window & Export Formats
messages:
From: Nikhil Rao <n.rao@acmehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Compliance <it-compliance@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: admin activity & audit logs for SIG/SOC2

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. Our auditor has requested a few concrete outputs to satisfy the SIG and SOC 2 evidence buckets: a) list of admin actions (user create/delete, role changes, API key operations), b) timestamps and actor identifiers for each action, c) the configurable retention window and d) recommendations for extracting snapshots for a third-party archive.

Can you confirm: 1) what exact fields are present in the admin activity ledger, 2) what export formats you support (CSV/ndjson/parquet), and 3) the standard retention policy for hosted accounts? We may need a 90-day point-in-time bundle and a longer running stream.

Appreciate a short runbook or example export.

Regards,
Nikhil
Lead IT Auditor, Acme Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Rao <n.rao@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: admin activity & audit logs for SIG/SOC2

Hi Nikhil — thanks, happy to help. High level answers up front, details/attached sample below:

- Fields we log (admin activity ledger): timestamp (UTC), actor_id (user email + internal id), actor_type (human/service), action_type (CREATE_USER, DELETE_USER, GRANT_ROLE, REVOKE_ROLE, CREATE_API_KEY, DELETE_API_KEY, ASSUME_ROLE), target_id (user/role/api_key id), ip_address, user_agent, request_id, request_payload_summary, outcome (SUCCESS/FAILURE), and trace_id when available.

- Export formats: CSV for human-readable snapshots, ndjson for event stream compatibility, and Parquet for columnar bulk transfers. Our export tool can package a time-bound snapshot and a metadata manifest.

- Retention: hosted accounts default to 180 days for admin activity; Dedicated/Private can be configured up to 7 years. For SOC 2 evidence requests we usually provide a 90-day snapshot plus the rolling 180-day stream unless the customer contract requires a different window.

Attached: activity_log_sample.csv (small extract), and a short export-playbook PDF with command examples.

Quick clarifying questions: do you want the 90-day bundle as CSV or ndjson? Also, will you need a signed manifest and checksum for ingestion into your archive?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Rao <n.rao@acmehealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-22T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: admin activity & audit logs for SIG/SOC2

Nikhil, Kim — adding a few operational notes to make ingestion easier:

- Export mechanics: we can generate a time-bounded ndjson stream and simultaneously produce a Parquet drop optimized for S3 transfers. We sign every export with an SHA256 checksum and include a manifest.json listing range, record count, and software version. (Manifest can be included inline or as a separate file.)

- Paging and rate: for large accounts we paginate exports by day-range buckets; if you need a single archive we can pre-compose into gzipped tarballs.

- Metadata to highlight in your evidence package: internal job id that executed the export, RedShift/DB snapshot id (if applicable), and the request_id header which maps to our trace log for incident correlation.

I'll attach the export-playbook; Kim — can you flag any fields in the sample that are non-standard for SIG?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Platform Operations
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Rao <n.rao@acmehealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-23T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: admin activity & audit logs for SIG/SOC2

Hi all — quick note from product/security perspective about fields and redaction:

- PII considerations: we log actor email and an internal actor_id; for external audits we can provide masked actor identifiers and a crosswalk file under an NDA. We do not log full request bodies by default — just a request_payload_summary which contains field names and sizes.

- Retention tiers: for compliance bundles we recommend: 90-day human-readable snapshot (CSV) + 365-day ndjson stream for reconciliation. If Acme needs longer retention we can enable extended retention (contract addendum).

- SIG/CAIQ mapping: action_type and outcome map directly to SIG control evidence points (administration & access controls). The manifest explains the mapping; see attached sig-questionnaire-answers.docx for the mapping table we prepared for similar customers.

- Where we provide proof of export: we include a signed manifest, SHA256 checksums, exporter job id, and a timestamped log entry referencing the export request_id. That entry is part of the admin ledger and can be cross-referenced in audits.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Product Security
From: Nikhil Rao <n.rao@acmehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-24T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: admin activity & audit logs for SIG/SOC2

Thanks — that answers our questions. We prefer: 1) 90-day CSV snapshot (human review), 2) 365-day ndjson stream for our ingestion, and 3) signed manifests + checksums. Please proceed with delivering the CSV bundle and ndjson stream. For the actor ids, please provide the masked crosswalk under NDA and include the manifest in the root of the archive.

Next steps: Kimberly — can you send an estimated delivery ETA and a secure link for download (or S3 bucket + IAM role) by end of day tomorrow? We'll prepare our ingestion job once received.

Regards,
Nikhil
Lead IT Auditor, Acme Health
